WITH date_dim_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dd.d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dd.d_date
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily
),
web_running AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           MAX(cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS run_max
    FROM web_v1
),
store_running AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           MAX(cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS run_max
    FROM store_v1
),
keys AS (
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM web_v1
    UNION
    SELECT item_sk, d_date FROM store_v1
),
combined AS (
    SELECT k.item_sk,
           k.d_date,
           web_row.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store_row.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM keys k
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT w.cume_sales
        FROM web_v1 w
        WHERE w.item_sk = k.item_sk AND w.d_date = k.d_date
    ) web_row ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT s.cume_sales
        FROM store_v1 s
        WHERE s.item_sk = k.item_sk AND s.d_date = k.d_date
    ) store_row ON true
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT c.item_sk,
           c.d_date,
           c.web_sales,
           c.store_sales,
           web_agg.run_max AS web_cumulative,
           store_agg.run_max AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT wr.run_max
        FROM web_running wr
        WHERE wr.item_sk = c.item_sk AND wr.d_date <= c.d_date
        ORDER BY wr.d_date DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) web_agg ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT sr.run_max
        FROM store_running sr
        WHERE sr.item_sk = c.item_sk AND sr.d_date <= c.d_date
        ORDER BY sr.d_date DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) store_agg ON true
)
SELECT *
FROM cumulative
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
